title: AlphaCNOT: Learning CNOT Minimization with Model-Based Planning
abstract: arXiv:2604.13812v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantum circuit optimization is a central task in quantum computing, as current NISQ devices suffer from error propagation that often scales with the number of operations. Among quantum operations, the CNOT gate is of fundamental importance, being the only two-qubit gate in the universal Clifford+T set. Minimizing CNOT gates is therefore particularly important, as these gates exhibit higher error rates and they typically introduce additional routing overhead due to hardware constraints. translated_title: AlphaCNOT：基于模型规划的CNOT门最小化学习方法
translated_abstract: 量子线路优化是量子计算中的一项核心任务，因为当前的NISQ（含噪声中等规模量子）设备存在误差传播问题，误差往往随操作数量的增加而累积。在各类量子操作中，CNOT门具有基础性的重要地位，它是通用Clifford+T门集合中唯一的二量子比特门。因此，最小化CNOT门数量尤为重要，因为这类门具有更高的错误率，并且由于硬件限制通常还会引入额外的路由开销。CNOT门最小化问题此前已通过启发式算法得到解决，例如著名的用于线性可逆综合（即无拓扑约束的CNOT最小化）的Patel-Markov-Hayes（PMH）算法，以及近期在更复杂的拓扑感知综合场景（其中每个CNOT只能作用于量子比特对的一个子集）中出现的基于强化学习（RL）的策略。我们提出了AlphaCNOT，一个基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的强化学习框架……
tldr: 提出AlphaCNOT——一个结合蒙特卡洛树搜索进行模型规划的强化学习框架，用于在拓扑感知约束下最小化量子线路中的CNOT门数量，超越了传统启发式方法（如PMH算法）和已有强化学习策略。
en_tdlr: AlphaCNOT is a reinforcement learning framework with model-based Monte Carlo Tree Search planning that minimizes CNOT gates in topology-aware quantum circuit synthesis, outperforming prior heuristics like PMH and existing RL-based approaches.
